text: 17-year-old male. The patient has been experiencing increasing pain and swelling in his right knee for the past 12 days. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive arthritis (formerly Reiter's syndrome).

The combination of asymmetric oligoarthritis (knee and ankle), urethritis (pain with urination), and your history of sexual activity is highly characteristic of this condition. Given the inflammatory nature, I will need to request specific blood work to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes. REQUEST TEST: ESR, CRP, RF, ANA, and Urinalysis.
